overview.heading: Development experience, connected to construction.
overview.body:
LCH Developments is a Toronto-based real estate development company working across purpose-built rental housing, mixed-use communities and heritage redevelopment. We develop our own projects and provide development management for owners and partners, bringing together feasibility, planning approvals, project economics and design coordination.

Through our affiliated construction manager, Elevate, construction expertise informs decisions from early planning through delivery. Our experience also includes helping owners, lenders and receivers move challenging projects toward completion.

process.heading: From project potential to a coordinated plan for delivery.
process.intro: We connect development strategy with the practical work of approvals, design, financing coordination and construction. These workstreams progress together, with decisions tested against cost, schedule and the needs of the finished building.

steps.title: Understand the opportunity
steps.body: We assess the site, planning context, market and ownership objectives. Feasibility studies, development budgets and schedules establish what the project can achieve and what needs to be resolved.

steps.title: Optimize the development
steps.body: We test building form, floorplates, unit mix, parking and major systems against rentable area, construction cost and long-term operation. We translate those decisions into coordinated direction for the design team.

steps.title: Coordinate the path to construction
steps.body: We manage consultants, municipal submissions and responses, while tracking servicing, agreements and permit requirements. Design and preconstruction advance together so approvals and construction planning remain aligned.

steps.title: Plan and build with Elevate
steps.body: Elevate brings estimating, trade input, constructability reviews, tendering and procurement into the process early. During construction, its project and site teams manage delivery while LCH continues development and owner oversight.

steps.title: Carry it through occupancy
steps.body: We coordinate occupancy approvals, outstanding municipal obligations and the transition to building operations. Working with Elevate and the wider project team, we support turnover, deficiencies and project closeout.

process.footnote: Budgets, cash flow, schedules and owner reporting connect each stage. Partnership and a willingness to rethink the plan shape how we work throughout.

elevate.heading: Development and construction, working together.
elevate.body:
LCH leads the development work: feasibility, approvals, design coordination and owner oversight. Elevate leads preconstruction and construction management. Working together early allows construction costs, trade input and sequencing to inform the design before decisions become difficult to change.

That coordination continues through tendering, construction and turnover, with responsibilities clearly assigned across the team.
